Unique names for source columns that collide with dat's

Source: R/matchData.R
matched_names.Rd

.matched first, then .matched2, .matched3 and so on, so chaining the same variable onto one table any number of times never produces two columns of the same name. A <var>_source column follows its variable's rename - CHL_source becomes CHL.matched_source beside CHL.matched - so the tag stays next to the value it describes.

Usage

matched_names(collisions, source_vars, taken)

Arguments

collisions

source columns whose names dat already has

source_vars

every column being joined from the source

taken

names already in use in dat

Value

one new name per element of collisions
